row: Located in the heart of Somerdale, the leading health professionals at White Horse Chiropractic Center are dedicated to helping you achieve your wellness objectives -- combining skill and expertise that spans the entire chiropractic wellness spectrum. Dr. Stanley Piltin is committed to bringing you better health and a better way of life by teaching and practicing the true principles of chiropractic wellness care.
